source.title: Honest Coffee Guide: 1Zpresso Q2 (heptagonal burrs) grind settings
source.notes: 1Zpresso's Q chart does not list cold brew.

procedure.en: Turn the adjustment dial under the burr clockwise to the tightest position. The number marked at the dot is your zero; it might not be 0. Count rotations, numbers and clicks counter-clockwise from there. Do not turn the handle within the first few clicks from zero.
procedure.pt-BR: Gire o dial de ajuste sob a mó no sentido horário até a posição mais apertada. O número marcado no ponto é o seu zero; pode não ser 0. Conte as voltas, os números e os cliques no sentido anti-horário a partir dali. Não gire a manivela nos primeiros cliques a partir do zero.

notes: Internal dial under the burr: 10 numbers per rotation, 30 clicks per rotation, 3 clicks per number; the official chart spans 4 rotations = 120 clicks. 25 µm per click (0.025 mm) is 1Zpresso's published burr travel, not particle size. Unlike the external-ring models, zero is the tightest position and the dial number there may not read 0. Q2 S differs only by the foldable handle; Q Air shares the chart. Zero tolerance of 3 clicks (one dial number) is a working figure: 1Zpresso states none for the Q. All values stored as clicks from zero.
